expected_level_description: You can: - determine the approach for your role within the team's delivery methodology - define and agree the scope of delivery for your role within a multidisciplinary team - negotiate and agree delivery priorities with the team and relevant stakeholders - clearly communicate the value of iterative delivery and realising benefits early

You can: - advise others how to ensure appropriate test coverage, data and scenarios, in line with acceptance criteria - analyse business risk and impacts of defects so that appropriate action can be taken to enable business acceptance - provide assurance on the suitability, business readiness and viability of delivered solutions

You can: - set standards for business modelling, including for the elicitation of appropriate information - assess the effectiveness of modelling techniques to enable continuous improvement - coach others in business modelling, leading the creation of models when appropriate - use business modelling outcomes to anticipate and influence decision making and strategy development

You can: - lead the identification of large-scale opportunities to deliver business performance improvements - set the direction for analysis, design and evaluation of business process improvements, including methods, tools and standards - set the direction for design, execution and assessment of business process tests and usability evaluations - coach others in designing, testing, implementing and assessing business process improvements

You can: - influence strategic decisions by challenging whether proposed change is likely to deliver real and evidenced value - work with the business and other professions to influence approaches for change adoption, business readiness and benefits management - position business analysis as a discipline that improves business readiness, adoption and outcomes

You can: - advise on approaches to options analysis, feasibility and impact assessments to ensure best practice is followed - ensure all streams of work align to the organisation's strategic context and goals - advise on how the organisation can use business analysis skills to add value - guide tactical decision making and influence strategic plans in a changing environment

skill: Defining and managing business needs, user needs and requirements
expected_level_description: You can: - set standards for defining and managing complex or large-scale business and user needs - use business and user needs to ensure proposed solutions align with organisational strategy - provide guidance and recommendations to ensure needs are traceable and managed - influence the prioritisation of needs, enabling tactical solutions and long-term strategic decision making

You can: - set the direction for the analysis of systems to align to business capabilities and strategy - set the direction for analysing and communicating system changes and the effect of change on stakeholders - work with other technical specialists to set and iterate standards for system and data modelling and documentation

You can: - direct the stakeholder relationship strategy for your teams - ensure stakeholder's objectives are set and support teams to meet them - influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders to resolve issues and enable progress

You can: - synthesise insights from multiple appropriate sources of evidence to provide a holistic understanding of user experience - identify patterns, root causes, and opportunities for improvement across journeys - ensure user experience insights are clearly linked to requirements, priorities, and design decisions - identify priorities for improving user experience, taking into consideration business and technical constraints

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload

You can: - lead hazard identification and risk assessment for a product or change - write and maintain hazard logs and clinical safety case reports - agree risk controls with product teams and check that they work - advise teams on applying clinical risk management standards

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements

You can: - design and build integrations using FHIR, HL7 version 2, and messaging patterns - write and profile FHIR resources and implementation guides - resolve complex mapping and data quality issues between systems
You can: - find and use the right codes for a data item or form - use terminology browsers and reference sets
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
